stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Fresh neem seeds are sown within weeks of collection, at the start of the monsoon.

stages.label: Sprouting
stages.text: The shoot breaks the soil in one to two weeks, carrying its first pair of leaves.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Compound leaves appear. Each seedling moves into its own nursery bag.

stages.label: Nursery sapling
stages.text: Hardened in full sun to 3–4 ft. This is the size we deliver most.

stages.label: Full-grown tree
stages.text: A dense evergreen crown and deep roots that shrug off Gujarat summers.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Small, honey-scented white flowers each March and April.

stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Hard, bean-like seeds from the long pods, soaked before sowing.

stages.label: Sprouting
stages.text: Germinates fast in the warm monsoon soil.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Feathery, fern-like leaves unfold. Potted into its own bag.

stages.label: Nursery sapling
stages.text: 4–5 ft, ready for avenues and gardens.

stages.label: Full-grown tree
stages.text: A wide umbrella canopy that drops its leaves briefly in late winter.

stages.label: In flower
stages.text: Covered in scarlet flowers from April to June.

stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Seeds from the flat woody pods, sown in the monsoon.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Glossy leaflets appear. Tolerates saline soil from the start.

stages.label: Nursery sapling
stages.text: 3–4 ft and ready to plant.

stages.label: Full-grown tree
stages.text: Dense, glossy shade, a favourite for Kutch and coastal sites.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Soft lilac flowers in spring.

stages.label: Pods
stages.text: Flat brown pods follow the flowers.

stages.label: Stone
stages.text: Rootstock is raised from a mango stone.

stages.label: Sprouting
stages.text: Coppery new leaves push out of the stone.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: The rootstock is grafted with Kesar wood so it fruits true.

stages.label: Grafted sapling
stages.text: 2–3 ft graft, the size most farmhouses buy.

stages.label: Full-grown tree
stages.text: A dense dome of dark leaves.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Panicles of tiny flowers in January.

stages.label: Fruiting
stages.text: Kesar mangoes ripen from April to June.

stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Glossy black seeds from the fruit raise the rootstock.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Grafted once the stem thickens.

stages.label: Grafted sapling
stages.text: 2–3 ft graft, ready to plant.

stages.label: Full-grown tree
stages.text: Compact evergreen, easy for backyards.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Small bell-shaped flowers among the leaves.

stages.label: Fruiting
stages.text: Sweet brown fruit through most of the year.

stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Small oval seeds, sown in warm, humid beds.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Grass-like first fronds, grown several to a pot so they clump.

stages.label: Nursery clump
stages.text: A 3 ft clump of golden canes.

stages.label: Full-grown clump
stages.text: Arching fronds on many golden stems.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Branched sprays of small yellow flowers below the leaves.

stages.label: Seed
stages.text: Large fibrous seeds, slow and uneven to sprout.

stages.label: Seedling
stages.text: Single strap leaves before the first feathered frond.

stages.label: Nursery palm
stages.text: 4 ft with its first full fox-tail fronds.

stages.label: Full-grown palm
stages.text: A smooth grey trunk under a bushy crown.

stages.label: Fruiting
stages.text: Clusters of bright red-orange fruit.

stages.label: Cutting
stages.text: Grown from hardwood cuttings, rooted in the nursery.

stages.label: Rooted plant
stages.text: New shoots and leaves once the roots take.

stages.label: Established bush
stages.text: Thorny, vigorous growth that can be trained on walls.

stages.label: In colour
stages.text: Magenta bracts through the dry months.

stages.label: Cutting
stages.text: Rooted from stem cuttings.

stages.label: Young plant
stages.text: Glossy leaves on fresh shoots.

stages.label: Budding
stages.text: Long buds form at the shoot tips.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Big red flowers almost daily in the warm months.

stages.label: Full bush
stages.text: A dense 2 m shrub.

stages.label: Cutting
stages.text: Rooted from semi-hard cuttings.

stages.label: Young plant
stages.text: Neat pairs of dark leaves.

stages.label: Established shrub
stages.text: A compact, rounded bush.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Ball-shaped orange clusters.

stages.label: Cutting
stages.text: Rooted cuttings, planted close for a hedge.

stages.label: Young plant
stages.text: Lime-gold leaves on new shoots.

stages.label: Clipped hedge
stages.text: A bright boundary after one season of trimming.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Lilac flower sprays if left unclipped.

stages.label: Golden berries
stages.text: Clusters of golden berries, the 'golden dewdrop'.

stages.label: Leaf cutting
stages.text: Propagated from leaf sections or divisions.

stages.label: New pups
stages.text: New shoots rise from the soil.

stages.label: Full pot
stages.text: Upright banded leaves filling the pot.

stages.label: Flowering
stages.text: Rarely, fragrant white flower spikes.
